time_base: integer seconds after the cache input_time (UTC); exact 1-second latest departure, uncapped by the planner grid
rule: cert field (router rule OR closed whole-road rule); full policy on these packets (checked precondition)

labels.window: leave_by equals the fire-free control: set by the scenario window/horizon and travel time
labels.present_fire: leave_by earlier than fire-free, unchanged when forecast new ignitions are removed: set by fire already burning
labels.forecast_dependent: leave_by changes when forecast new ignitions are removed; both values given
labels.no_checked_route: no departure second in [0,H] has a checked route (proven within the model)
labels.not_computed: origin absent from the ablation run
